stratum: # design=reselect: the budget is re-filled from scratch inside every
#   resample, so the composition of the top of each ranking is
#   resampled too. design=fixed: the two budget slices are held at the
#   ones the observed ranking produced and the resample only re-weights
#   associations (shared members move together, so it stays paired).
# 'point' is the statistic each design's replicates are compared to.
# trustworthy=False means the bootstrap on that row cannot support an
#   interval. resolvable=False is stronger: the comparison itself is
#   not answerable at this budget (too few associations fit, or most of
#   a slice is an arbitrary tie-break) — see 'verdict', and do not quote
#   any interval from that budget however trustworthy the row looks.
